# Arcana Encyclopedia: The Maze

To manifest the *Maze* is to stitch the ether into a cage of impossible geometry. As the magus draws upon the Weave, the air becomes brittle, feeling like thin glass under immense tension. You do not merely strike your foe; you fold their local reality inward, knotting the threads of space until they snap into a demiplanar prison.

To onlookers, the victim dissolves into flickering, translucent shards of marble and shadow. To the wretched soul within, the world twists into an infinite, non-Euclidean corridor of shifting stone where logic fails and silence screams. 

Legend attributes this cruel masterpiece to the **Hermit-Queen Elara**. Seeking to hide her mortal lover from a vengeful god, she wove a sanctuary so intricate that she herself could never retrieve him. It is whispered that he wanders there still, tracing the same cold walls in the dark between worlds, forever a single turn away from home.

**Scholarly Note:** *Exercise caution; the Weave resists such folding. One slip of the mind, and the labyrinth may claim the architect instead.*
